notes:
Seed token = BPE id for 'Hello' (single-token).

Primary oracle: llama.cpp libllama 0.0.8849 (ROCm 7.1.1, gfx906, 4x MI50) via POST /completion {prompt:[9419], n_predict:8, temperature:0, cache_prompt:false, return_tokens:true, n_probs:10}. Decoded: ',\n\nI am trying to use the' = [11, 271, 40, 1044, 4313, 310, 958, 279].

Secondary oracle (diagnostic): candle qwen35moe example (HIP, 4x MI50, CANDLE_RAW_PROMPT=1 patch) produces [11, 353, 599, 264, 3377, 440, 279, 2614] = ', I have a problem with the'. candle and llama.cpp agree on token 1 but diverge tokens 2+ due to F16/F32 micro-arithmetic differences between their two implementations. We match **llama.cpp exactly** for all 8 tokens.

V1.7.4 resolution path:
  (a) topk_f32 kernel hardcoded TOPK_MAX_EXPERTS=128 → OOB LDS write on Qwen3.6's n_experts=256 → non-deterministic output. Fixed 2026-04-21 (project_v1_7_4_a_topk_oob_fix.md).
  (b) full-attention used swiglu_f16 (= gate*sigmoid(gate)*attn) instead of sigmoid_mul (= sigmoid(gate)*attn) — an extra factor of gate per element → layer 3 diverged 10-25× from llama.cpp, cascading through 37 remaining layers. Found via llama-eval-callback per-layer A/B: layers 0..2 (GDN) matched to F16 precision, layer 3 (first full-attn) diverged. Fixed 2026-04-21 (project_v1_7_4_b_sigmoid_gate.md).

Regenerate reference tokens via:
  LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/artefact/llama.cpp/build/bin:/opt/rocm-7.1.1/lib:/opt/rocm-7.1.1/core-7.13/lib \

  curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/completion -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"prompt":[9419],"n_predict":8,"temperature":0,"cache_prompt":false,"return_tokens":true}'

Per-layer A/B mode: FLAMBEAU_PARITY_LAYER_DUMP=1 on our side; llama-eval-callback + grep 'l_out-N' on llama.cpp's side.
